summary: Monohull is a single-voice analogue-modelled monosynth that puts all of the FM-1's processing into one voice, spending spare CPU on unison and effects.
features: Morphing saw, pulse, triangle and sine oscillators with sync and sub
Five filters: transistor ladder, diode ladder, OTA, Sallen-Key, state-variable
Unison, Juno-style chorus, ping-pong delay and a Rings-derived reverb
Scheduler adds extras only while CPU allows
Class-compliant USB MIDI device, playable from a computer
No patch saving yet; never touches other firmwares' data
